text: Which genes are hepatocyte-specific in the single-cell data?
plan: Cell type category (scRNA): Hepatocytes / Cell type enriched
understanding: The user is searching for genes that show hepatocyte-specific expression in single-cell RNA sequencing data.

trail.why: The question specifically asks for genes that are hepatocyte-specific in the single-cell RNA-seq data, which corresponds to the 'Cell type enriched' category (at least four-fold higher expression in hepatocytes compared to any other cell type) under the 'Hepatocytes' cell type.

requirements.why: This field classifies RNA specificity across individual single-cell types, which directly covers specificity in hepatocytes for single-cell data, unlike Cell type group category (scRNA) which is aggregated into broader cell type groups.
